product.name: Balboa 32U4 Balancing Robot Kit (No Motors or Wheels)

warnings: The text gives no chassis dimensions, so every size is an estimate. Wheel diameter (80 mm recommended) comes from the specs and sets the scale in the assembled photo. The board looks slightly wider than the wheel's overall diameter. I estimated the chassis width without wheels as about 100 mm, including the motor bodies. The depth of about 50 mm assumes a six-AA holder lying flat. The height of about 115 mm assumes the frame ribs stand roughly one wheel diameter plus margin above the board. Because the photos show no printed dimensions and no clear hole pattern, I left the holes array empty. The kit contains many parts, so these bounds are a rough envelope for the assembled chassis, not a single part's size.
All dimensions are estimates; no chassis dimensions provided.
Board components, gears, bearings, motor clips, fasteners, and wheels omitted.
Rib shape approximated as elliptical rings; holes in the ribs omitted.
Motors and wheels are not part of the kit; the motor stubs only approximate the envelope width.
Orientation follows boundsMm (Y height 50), though the photo shows the robot standing upright.
